digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output and prompt caching
propositions: Direct Anthropic structured cache canary must execute two identical-prefix calls (write then read) through PydanticAIRunner and record usage counts (requests, input_tokens, cache_write_tokens, cache_read_tokens) and model id without exposing credentials
Bedrock structured cache canary must execute the same two-call write/read sequence with ambient AWS credentials and record the same usage counts, model id, and complete-vs-omit branch decisions

Observed cache accounting across both providers must match the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md section 'The structured retry layers and their accounting (one bounded operation)' for all four live calls

The complete-vs-omit branch must be directly observed via instrumentation of _make_wire_projection to record messages_in, messages_kept, and whether any failed output was omitted on each before_model_request invocation
